item.title: McDonald's 'Pokémon' Happy Meal Is Officially Confirmed, And It's Sooner Than You Think
item.description: The internet has been buzzing with rumors of an impending McDonald's Pokémon Happy Meal, and the fast food chain has finally confirmed that the promo is happening. Here's when you can start purchasing the special McDonald's Pokémon collaboration and what you can expect from the prizes inside.

item.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket Just Got a Game-Changing Feature That’s Worth Coming Back For
item.description: It’s hard to believe, but Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket is already two years old. To celebrate, The Pokémon Company just rolled out what might be the app’s most significant update yet. It adds two new Dual Fusion booster packs to the game, introducing cards with multiple types to the competitive meta. Solo battles, missions, and more have been reworked in a way that makes the game feel fresh again.

item.title: 10 perfect books from before 1900 that are still easy to read today
item.description: Classic literature can, at times, be intimidating to jump into as a reader. The language was so different in novels back then, making it, at times, hard for the modern reader to fully understand. If you give them a chance, however, what you'll find is that classics are classics for a reason. Despite being written hundreds of years ago, they continue to resonate with readers today, bridging the gap between authors who are long gone and readers discovering them for the first time. It's a beautiful thing, really.

item.title: Bloodborne Movie Officially Sets Director in New Update
item.description: While Bloodborne may remain trapped in PlayStation 4 exclusivity jail until the end of time, at least its movie adaptation is making progress. YouTuber Seán “Jacksepticeye” McLoughlin is producing the R-rated animated film alongside PlayStation Productions and Lyrical Animation. In an interview with IGN , McLoughlin shared the latest on the project, which was announced at CinemaCon in April.

item.title: Alien: Isolation 2 Fans Cheer as Devs Confirm ‘Core Pillar'
item.description: As major corporations like Sony and Microsoft continue to push the games industry towards an all-digital future , players are left wondering whether the next title they are excited about will even get a physical release. Thankfully, Creative Assembly has some good news for everyone who has been eagerly awaiting Alien: Isolation 2 .

item.title: Fallout Star Officially Confirms Major Season 3 Milestone
item.description: Prime Video's Fallout series has proven over its first two seasons that video game adaptations can succeed when handled with care and creativity . Anticipation for the third season of the show is high, although fans will be waiting until at least 2027 to see what's in store for Lucy, The Ghoul, and Maximus. The good news is that the third season of Prime Video's Fallout TV show just hit a major milestone, according to star Walton Goggins, who confirms that filming on the show is nearing its end.

item.title: Spring Hokubu region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The spring Hokubu region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 6, "Horizon Meets." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: Epic Makes Survival Horror PC Game Completely Free for a Limited Time
item.description: The Epic Games Store is offering a great free PC game this week for users. For a limited time, you can grab a retro survival horror game at no charge.

item.title: Pokémon's TCG World Is Already Blowing Up Over 30th Anniversary's Eeveelution Release
item.description: Whether you're a Pokémon Trading Card Game scalper or collector, all eyes are on the release of the 30th Anniversary Ultra Premium Collection . Fans are salivating at the set's Espeon and Umbreon special illustration cards, and tempted by its exclusive Future Rare Pikachu cards. The product isn't on shelves yet, but resale prices are already through the roof. Early shipments of the UPC have started to trickle into the wild, and it's clear that the release will send shock waves through the TCG world.

item.title: Where to find Kinkaku-ji Temple in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: Kinkaku-ji Temple is an iconic location in Forza Horizon 6. Here's where to find the golden temple and how to get there.
